task.title: Apply the attached system table design across SpecterStudio
task.objective: Replace SpecterStudio's table presentation with the attached design's shared search, filter, table, and pagination treatment while preserving all existing table data, behavior, handlers, permissions, and page structure. Limit product changes to the table component and its shared CSS.

scope: Change table presentation only; preserve page layouts, table data, filtering logic, sorting logic, pagination state, actions, routes, and preload contracts.
Reuse the existing table component and Hologram design tokens; do not add a parallel component system or dependency.
Treat the attached HTML as a visual reference only and do not copy its demo data or simulated behavior.
accessibility: Preserve semantic table markup, labels, aria-sort state, keyboard operation, visible focus styling, responsive overflow, and reduced-motion behavior.
offline: Do not add remote assets, fonts, scripts, dependencies, or runtime network access.

acceptance.description: All existing SpecterStudio table families share the attached design language for their surface, filters, headers, rows, empty states, and pagination without changing page structure or non-table components.
Existing search, filter, applied-filter, sorting, selection, paging, and row-action behavior remains wired to the original handlers and state.
AI memory, the code graph, and roadmap sources accurately record the completed table-only change.
